$comment: Accepted ungrounded claims. Every entry needs a reason naming where the number actually comes from. Regenerate the skeleton with `node evals/factuality/run.mjs --write-baseline`, then write the reasons by hand. An entry whose claim no longer appears in the content fails the gate as stale.

entries.phrase: …shika Singh and me, as team leader). Selected among the top 30 at the AI4Humanity Summit. Presentation Video demonstration…
entries.reason: True but not in the README. The rank comes from the owner's résumé (`resume.pdf`, Projects → Accurate Precise Timely: "Selected among the top 30 teams to pitch offline at the AI4Humanity Summit ... in a hackathon of 150+ teams (Certificate)") and is restated in `src/content/site.ts` (`experience` achievements: "Top 30 of 150+ teams — AI4Humanity Summit"). The APT README lists only team, stack and links, and records no competition result.

entries.phrase: …mates across games. Work is currently in review at EMNLP 2026.
entries.reason: True but not in the README. The submission status was supplied by the owner and recorded in `aidlc-docs/efforts/006-atomnet-project/effort-state.md` ("Status published as 'in review at EMNLP 2026'") and `requirements-delta.md` R-027. The AtomNet README describes the architecture and results but never states a venue; its only EMNLP mention is a citation of ASTRA (Kwon et al., EMNLP 2025), a different paper.

entries.phrase: …osa for MFCC extraction, PyAudio; configurable sample rate (22050 Hz, matching training), chunk duration (0.5 s) and MQTT topic.…
entries.reason: In the README, but as a configuration literal rather than a measurement: the Configuration section shows `"sample_rate": 22050,  # Audio Hz (Must match model training)`. The value and its unit are on opposite sides of a comment marker, so the grounding rule — which deliberately requires a unit to sit next to its number — cannot bind them. Accepted rather than relaxing that rule, because a false "grounded" verdict is the failure mode this suite exists to prevent.

entries.phrase: …sample rate (22050 Hz, matching training), chunk duration (0.5 s) and MQTT topic. IoT. Paho-MQTT publishing to a HiveMQ b…
entries.reason: In the README, but as a configuration literal with no unit attached: the Configuration section shows `"chunk_duration": 0.5,  # Responsiveness (Lower = Faster updates)`. The seconds unit is stated in the surrounding prose of the case study, not in the README line, so the number cannot be bound to `s` in the source. Accepted for the same reason as the sample rate above.
